mentions.name: inslib
mentions.description: An open-source inertial navigation library released in embedded C and Python, developed from the author's PhD thesis work; benchmarks in the comment show it beating ArduPilot's navigation subsystem.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been working on my inertial navigation library. It actually beats ArduPilot’s navigation subsystem in my benchmarks. I’ve been working on these algorithms since my PhD thesis and now I am releasing the stuff as open source embedded C and Python library
